info.value: The wallpaper itself cannot take the keyboard: Windows gives those letters to the desktop icons. Run start.bat and double-click a task to type in a normal window. Or select a task and type in the box below.

applyBtn.text: Replace the selected task or title

addTaskBtn.text: Add the text as a new task on the selected sticker

newNoteBtn.text: Create a new sticker with this title

directTyping.text: Type directly on the wallpaper. In Lively: Settings, Wallpaper, Interaction, Input, Keyboard. That hides the desktop icons.
